name: Magic Hour
long_description: Magic Hour is a browser-based creative platform and API for generating and editing video, images, and audio. Creators and teams use more than 100 tools, including face swap, lip sync, image-to-video, text-to-video, image editing, and voice generation. Developers integrate the same capabilities through our REST API, official SDKs, and hosted MCP server.
one_liner: AI media creation platform for creators and developers

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Runbo is the co-founder and CEO of Magic Hour. Previously, he was a senior data scientist at Meta where he worked on numerous zero-to-one consumer social products at NPE (New Product Experimentation).

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: David is the co-founder and CTO of Magic Hour. Previously, he worked as a full stack engineer at Skillz, leading multiple product development teams from Series B to IPO. He worked across the entire tech stack, from user interface down to infrastructure management.

launches.title: Magic Hour - Create engaging videos using AI
launches.tagline: Magic Hour makes it easy for anyone to create professional-quality videos
launches.body:
Hi everyone! We're [Runbo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/runboli/) and [David](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidhu2000/), and we’re building [Magic Hour](https://magichour.ai/), a video creation platform that makes it easy for anyone to create professional-quality videos.

Imagine swapping your face onto [Anne Hathaway’s](https://vimeo.com/919285653?share=copy) in The Devil Wears Prada, or transforming [Michael Jordan](https://www.instagram.com/reel/C0etTFPu82Y/) into a marble statue shooting a game-winner in the Colosseum.

**Try Our Website**: [**magichour.ai**](https://magichour.ai)

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/uj-ZNSVmwSdWtWRUhHFLgD15D5jMgY15bfHB-ZqNZqo4widCmOnzG23lk7XMCuZahyrBie0WUW1T6SyhgbAocdpOanu9vfNtZ6Io9DNQdt2ni5BGj1Tth5gy3JMk2PsTtv879SvBJeKxY3UQusUQvYs)

**The Problem**

Many creators, professionals, and businesses struggle to produce enough engaging, high-quality videos due lack of video production expertise and constraints on time and budget.

**The Solution**

We take the best open-source AI models, figure out the best settings, and put them in a user-friendly UX so anyone can create high-quality videos in three easy steps: **choose a template, customize it, and share it**.

**About Us**

Our moms are best friends and introduced us in 1997 (left). Magic Hour is born out of experiences helping our parents market their small businesses, where we learned how hard it is to create engaging video content.

![](https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/wO2hXAv9DwXnRIIawRUkI2NMU2Jz4N3pLBWLRahJBSmMQl-tsjBHfEcA3iCanBClT4KculXKeeR0uavWcXtmTRqeKk0sqyMXuVrj-cXbQ3oHPUW16DyTDnYECf0DYdXFuYCc9zN6QKQ8eWdhOYIf_KY)

**Our ask**

* Try <https://magichour.ai>
* Share with friends and family
* Give us feedback at [founders@magichour.ai](mailto:support@magichour.ai) 
* If you have any connections to businesses that make a lot of video content, especially professional sports teams, we’d love to connect

Feel free to reach out at [founders@magichour.ai](mailto:support@magichour.ai) anytime!
